panels.scene: Sam at his desk far away on a video call laptop, a blank page and pencil beside him, relaxed. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: Want to fill in a one-page sheet together?
panels.caption: Do it together.

panels.scene: June at her kitchen table with a pen and a sheet of paper, reading glasses on, the small green kettle on the stove.
panels.caption: In their words.

panels.scene: June sliding the finished sheet into a folder on a shelf, Sam small on the laptop screen smiling, both at ease.
panels.caption: One copy each.
